adjudication.rationale: In the new `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, the only gate is `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host` (no explicit `blank?` check and no scheme check). However, in the flow introduced here, `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` raises if `SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?`, so `RetrieveTopic` jobs should not be enqueued when the setting is unset/blank, and when it is set (e.g. "eviltrout.com") a `file:///...` URL’s host (nil/empty) will not match and will be rejected. The finding’s specific bypass scenario (unset host default '' plus `URI#host == ''` for `file:///...`) is not directly verifiable from the diff and appears unreachable in the normal controller→job path. Still, mirroring the controller’s blank-check / restricting to http(s) would be a worthwhile hardening improvement if `TopicRetriever` is ever called from other entry points.
